name: higgsfield

field_reviews.reason: docs.higgsfield.ai shows every request authenticated with header 'Authorization: Key ${HF_API_KEY_ID}:${HF_API_KEY_SECRET}' - key-pair credentials created in Higgsfield Cloud.

The 'Authorization: Key id:secret' scheme is a non-standard API-key variant, so api_key plus custom is a fair classification. The MCP path authenticates via the Higgsfield account instead of keys ('No API keys to manage'), which the draft covers under MCP rather than API auth.

Official help center (higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/business/team-and-business-higgsfield): 'Register at cloud.higgsfield.ai: you can generate an API key immediately' and 'No sales call is required for standard access'; also 'Credits from your regular Higgsfield plan can't be transferred to the API: API credits are separate.' The plans FAQ states there is no trial period, so paid API credits are effectively required for generation - self_serve_paid fits.

One asynchronous generation API spanning images, video, audio, and 3D at platform.higgsfield.ai (30+ models), plus file upload/storage and request status/cancel - generation-focused, single-domain, write-heavy; medium is reasonable.

Hosted REST API at platform.higgsfield.ai documented at docs.higgsfield.ai; vendor-hosted MCP server promoted on higgsfield.ai/cli and higgsfield.ai/mcp. Both the hosted API and the CLI/MCP are official: the API is the documented developer product, and the CLI (@higgsfield/cli, github.com/higgsfield-ai/cli) plus MCP are official vendor tooling layered on the same account.

higgsfield.ai/cli (vendor domain) instructs adding 'the Higgsfield MCP server URL in your agent's settings' with account-based auth and no API keys; FAQ confirms MCP is the official connection mechanism for Claude/OpenClaw/Hermes etc. Independently confirmed docs.composio.dev/toolkits/higgsfield.md returns 404 - no Composio toolkit.

Immediate self-serve key generation at cloud.higgsfield.ai, public docs with cURL/SDK examples, async polling and webhooks - an integration can be built right away (paying for API credits to generate).
No approval, partner, or sales gate for standard API access per the official help center; cost of API credits is captured in access=self_serve_paid rather than as a blocker.

notes: Adversarial focus per hint (CLI vs hosted API): both are official and vendor-owned - the hosted asynchronous REST API at platform.higgsfield.ai (docs.higgsfield.ai, auth 'Authorization: Key id:secret', self-serve keys from cloud.higgsfield.ai) is the developer product, and the @higgsfield/cli npm CLI plus the hosted MCP server (higgsfield.ai/cli, account-based auth) are official companion tooling. Opened the draft's docs.higgsfield.ai, help-center, and /cli evidence URLs; all exist and match. API credits are separate from consumer plan credits and there is no trial period per the official plans FAQ, supporting self_serve_paid. Composio 404 re-confirmed. All eight fields hold.
